name: Hibiscus Instant Chat
author: Hibiscus Technolab

sections.description:
Hibiscus Instant Chat allows you to engage your website visitors instantly with a clean and lightweight chat widget. Enable direct messaging, set default greetings, and position the chat button anywhere on your site. Perfect for improving customer engagement and increasing conversions.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings and enter your WhatsApp phone number.
sections.faq:
Is this free?

Yes — the plugin is free and open-source under the GPLv2+ license.

How do I change the WhatsApp number?

Go to the plugin settings page and update the phone number field.
